parallels.note: They answered that they didn’t know where it was from.

translations.web: The man answered them, “How amazing! You don’t know where he comes from, yet he opened my eyes.
translations.bsb: “That is remarkable indeed!” the man said. “You do not know where He is from, and yet He opened my eyes.
translations.kjv: The man answered and said unto them, Why herein is a marvellous thing, that ye know not from whence he is, and yet he hath opened mine eyes.
translations.asv: The man answered and said unto them, Why, herein is the marvel, that ye know not whence he is, and yet he opened mine eyes.
